description: The company's email alert rules (delay over N days, arrived, delivered, tracking failed), their scope (all shipments, a tag or a carrier) and how many people get them. Read only: rules are created and changed in the web app (Settings > Notifications). Optional: include_inactive (default false) to add paused rules. Returns: rules[] {id, name, summary, rule_type, delay_days, delay_mode, failure_count, scope, scope_value, is_active, recipients {all_members, members, extra_emails}}.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.
